resources.string: Edge swipes: dock, app switcher, drawer and panels

Edge uses this service to draw thin invisible strips along the screen edges so you can swipe from any app: left for the dock, right to switch apps, bottom for the app drawer and top for notifications and quick settings. It also locks the screen on double-tap, notes which app is in front to build the recent-apps list, and takes a screenshot of the app in front to show as its card in the app switcher. Screenshots stay in memory only. Edge does not read screen content, and nothing leaves your phone.
